interface.longDescription:
Control panel URL: http://127.0.0.1:8765 — open it in the Codex sidebar browser (costs no quota; desktop shortcut also available after install).

Keep long tasks and goals running unattended. When the ChatGPT usage limit interrupts a conversation, AutoResume Guard waits for the quota window to reset and continues it — goals via the official continue action, ordinary threads via a resume prompt — with your chosen model and reasoning effort per resume.
